_meta.description: Rosetta Stone mapping .dat AuxAeroData keys to typed struct fields.

type_meanings.ID_INT: single integer (also used for booleans; see field default)
type_meanings.ID_VECTOR: three doubles (x y z), typically a body-frame position

_meta.usage: f4-convert uses this map to populate the typed AuxAero struct from the rawAuxAeroData verbatim map. f4-data uses it to validate that every key in a JSON has a known field mapping. If a key appears in a .dat file but not in this map, it is captured verbatim into rawAuxAeroData but does not get a typed field — that is by design, not a bug.
